gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.proxyDesc: Route Electron and Gateway traffic through your local proxy client.
gateway.proxyServerHelp: The default proxy for all requests. Bare host:port values default to HTTP.
gateway.proxyHttpServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTP requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyHttpsServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTPS requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyAllServerHelp: Advanced fallback for SOCKS-capable clients and protocols such as Telegram. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyBypassHelp: Semicolon, comma, or newline separated hosts that should connect directly.
gateway.proxyRestartNote: Saving reapplies Electron networking and restarts the Gateway immediately. Regular Gateway restarts keep existing Telegram channel proxy values when proxy is disabled; save while disabled to clear them.

advanced.browserBridgeDesc: Connect Google Chrome on this machine. The first use asks for confirmation in SClaw. Install the extension once; after that it attaches tabs automatically and never closes them.
advanced.browserBridgeInstallFailed: Could not prepare the extension files
advanced.browserBridgeGuideDesc: Chrome does not let apps install extensions directly. After the listing is live, this dialog can open the Chrome Web Store. Until then, follow the local steps once.
advanced.browserBridgeGuideStoreUnavailable: Not listed on the Chrome Web Store yet. Use Load unpacked below.
advanced.browserBridgeGuideStep1: The extension folder is open and its path is on the clipboard.
advanced.browserBridgeGuideStep2: In Chrome, open chrome://extensions and press Enter.
advanced.browserBridgeGuideStep3: Turn on Developer mode, click Load unpacked, and paste the copied path. After it loads, click the extension icon to open the side panel and send a prompt.
advanced.browserBridgeConsentMessage: SClaw will connect to and control Google Chrome on this machine to open or operate pages. Your tabs will not be closed. Allow?
advanced.browserBridgeConsentWithUrl: SClaw will connect to Google Chrome and open: {{url}}. Your tabs will not be closed. Allow?
